summary: TeamNest.ai AI Conversation Mode Phase 2 Batch 2 tested. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed (threaded ai-action for all 5 actions returns {ok:true}/{started:true,active:true}; unknown action → 400; invalid chat/msg → 404; rolling summary verified populated in DB with structured bullets after 4 AI turns — direct Mongo check on session doc showed context_summary of 800+ chars with 'Main topic', 'User goal', 'Key decisions'; multi-assistant switch banner first-call no-op verified via message list). Web: all 4 ai-action-toggle testids present in DOM, clicking one opens ai-action-menu with all 5 required child testids (ask_about/summarize_thread/continue_ai/draft_response/explain_decision); clicking continue_ai keeps 'Continuing with @ai' indicator + Exit AI button visible in composer. Mobile UI not exercised in this run (backend + code-review only for mobile).
action_items: Mobile long-press msg-action-modal path was not exercised in this run — main agent to self-test on mobile Expo preview or request a follow-up mobile-only pass. Code review of /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx confirms the testIDs exist (msg-action-modal, msg-action-ask_about, msg-action-summarize_thread, msg-action-continue_ai, msg-action-draft_response, msg-action-explain_decision).

Consider surfacing 'Active AI changed from @X to @Y' banner test via a second addressable AI agent — @devmanager path requires a development-capable chat (chat.kind='development' + bot_role_ids includes devmgr). The note_active_assistant function itself is unit-testable via unittest.mock but was covered indirectly by verifying no false-positive banners appear on first invocation.
context_summary is stored internally but never exposed via /api/chats/{id}/ai-session — consider adding it to _public_session for UI debug/observability (optional; no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: services/ai_conversation.py note_active_assistant correctly guards first invocation (no session or prev==new → no banner post). Broadcasts via manager after insert. LGTM.

services/ai_runtime.py:453 uses answer_count % SUMMARY_EVERY_TURNS == 0 — this fires on turn 4, 8, 12… Good cadence. The refresh coroutine is fire-and-forget (asyncio.create_task) so a slow LLM call cannot block the AI answer path.
routes/ai_conversation.py:264 handle_ai_command is dispatched via asyncio.create_task for non-continue actions — correct fire-and-forget shape. Response returns quickly ({ok:true}).

AIActionIn model has no whitelist for `action`; the dict lookup in _AI_ACTIONS + explicit 400 fallback correctly guards unknown values. Consider using Literal[...] typing for OpenAPI docs clarity (minor).

routes/chats.py:1466 only sets _invoked=('devmanager','@devmanager') when triggered_dev_agents is truthy, but that flag is only set for chat.kind=='development'. Users switching between two custom AI employees (deployed via schedule_deployed_employee_if_mentioned) won't produce a switch banner — banner is limited to @ai ↔ @devmanager for now. Documented behaviour, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% web (menu + all 5 items + continue_ai flow verified); mobile not exercised
